item.title: Celeriter an clārē? · Latin only × 3
item.description: Too much coffee, a carrot, beautiful birds, and today's chat with ChatGPT: speak fast, or speak clearly? Quotes: Īra furor brevis est (Horace, Letters 1.2), Rem tenē, verba sequentur (Cato the Elder), Sit sermō vester: est, est; nōn, nōn (Matthew 5:37). Latin only. The whole dialogue 3 times.

item.title: Fābulae · Latin only × 3
item.description: Latin stories about the family: a son who won't sleep, a wet dog, the cheese Marcus always forgets, and two daughters who find out they're in the stories. Easy stories or hard ones: which are better? Then Christmas and the Nativity. Quotes: Sinite parvulōs venīre ad mē (Mark 10:14), Glōria in altissimīs Deō (Luke 2:14). Latin only. The whole dialogue 3 times.

item.title: Domī labōrō · Latin only × 3
item.description: Working from home: getting up late, the kids after school, a client meeting tomorrow. Home or the city: which is better? Quotes: Festīnā lentē (Augustus), Venīte ad mē omnēs quī labōrātis (Matthew 11:28), Carpe diem (Horace, Odes 1.11). Latin only. The whole dialogue 3 times.
